style.backgroundSystem: alternating off-white fields #FFFFFF, pale stone-grey panels #E8E9EB and honed marble-look surfaces #F2F1EE, with at most two deep charcoal panels #3A3B3D reserved for macro and closing contrast; no random scenery
style.direction: clean wholesome everyday-lunch ecommerce, minimal infographic detail page
style.iconSystem: consistent thin-line icons, 2px uniform stroke, single accent #2F5A87, rounded square geometry, plus a recurring three-dot accent marker
style.lightingSystem: cool-neutral soft studio light, key from upper-left, diffuse fill on the shadow side, 5500K, gentle contact shadows only, never floating product
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean off-white background #FFFFFF, pale stone-grey panel #E8E9EB, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, and one steel-blue accent #2F5A87 (substitutable by {accent_color}); cool-neutral studio lighting with a soft upper-left key, diffuse fill and gentle contact shadows at 5500K; modern geometric sans-serif only; consistent thin-line icon style with 2px strokes; bracketed 「」 headline marks and a recurring three-dot accent marker; alternating off-white fields, pale stone panels and honed marble-look surfaces, with deep charcoal #3A3B3D used only for macro and closing contrast; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no printed digits or spec values rendered in-image.
noDrift: no printed digits, units or spec values rendered in-image
style.presentationRules: the same closed-strapped 3/4 product angle anchors hero and closing frames; overhead 90-degree only for instruction, food and lid frames; parts always rest on a surface with their own contact shadow; product never clipped by frame edge
style.surfaceSystem: honed stone / marble-look counter #F2F1EE with a pale wood edge for lifestyle frames, matte paper-white for infographic frames
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; bracketed 「」 headline marks, 28-40pt section headlines, 16-20pt subtitles, 10-14pt thin labels; all rendered copy is placeholder-driven, never dense body text
